ImageDescription.value:
This shop features its longitude and latitude right on its sign.

Do you see that 24.17, 120.72 on their sign? We'll those are their coordinates, rounded down quite a bit. Anyway, the common person perhaps would not have a clue to what those numbers meant. But we map lovers can tell at one glance.

So what's the distance between 24.17 and 24.18? 

$ units 40000km/360/100
